title: Fish Farms Feed the World
reason: The video describes the importance and statistics of fish farming, connecting it to global seafood production and consumption.

tasks.task: Present the concept of fish farming and its global impact.

subtasks.text: Introduce the idea of fish farming as a significant component of seafood production.
Highlight the surprising fact that most of the fish we eat is not wild but comes from fish farms.

tasks.task: Emphasize the scale and importance of fish farming in global food production.

subtasks.text: Explain that more than half of the world's seafood is produced through fish farming.
Stress the crucial role of fish farming in feeding the growing population.

tasks.task: Connect fish farming to everyday consumption.

subtasks.text: Mention the example of enjoying tasty salmon sushi to illustrate the impact of fish farming.
Conclude by acknowledging fish farming as a significant achievement of human innovation.
